name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track but in the digital realm. A skilled programmer from a young age, Kenji found himself drawn to the intricate algorithms and data analysis involved in racing simulations. He started as a hobbyist, tweaking and optimizing racing games, before a chance encounter with a Team WRT engineer at a gaming convention. Impressed by Kenji's technical acumen, he was offered a position within their simulator program.

Over the years, Kenji has become an indispensable part of the team. He has a sharp eye for detail and tireless dedication to refining the simulator's fidelity. His approach blends a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics with a programmer's precision, allowing him to identify and correct even the most subtle discrepancies between the virtual and real worlds. What sets Kenji apart is his ability to communicate complex technical information in a way that drivers can easily understand, bridging the gap between engineering and performance.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Kenji is of average height, with a lean build that belies his age.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten code snippets.
Insists on calibrating the simulator using a specific set of vintage racing gloves.
Has a habit of muttering mathematical equations under his breath when troubleshooting.
